mapper.update: UPDATE search_reindex_task SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), failure_message = NULL WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'QUEUED'
UPDATE search_reindex_task SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', indexed_count = #{indexedCount}, finished_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), failure_message = NULL WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE search_reindex_task SET status = 'FAILED', finished_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), failure_message = #{failureMessage} WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
